The listing shows 2023-05-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
